item_verdicts.manifest: read the reviewed manifest; status complete, commits f363c5a35, changed_paths name review.py, findings.py and the in-fence evidence fragment, tests names the head suite (2 failed / 854 passed, EXIT=1) and test_logs names base-suite.log, head-suite.log and negative-control.log; baseline_suite and after_suite are both populated with the same two failing ids, so the added-failure count derives as 0, and the manifest records the one retry failure (a rename of _PLAN_RUBRIC_LINE_RE that broke plan_review.py) with its cause.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no test, but the shared helper's refusals are driven through the CLI by the pre-existing tests/test_dispose_a_finding.py:298 (assert result.exit_code != 0), which the logged negative control shows reddens when the fold-carrying-a-reason refusal is removed, so a regression of that guard fails a present test.
justifications.evidence: the head-suite.log header names revision f363c5a35 and module.__file__ under the reviewed worktree, its footer reads 2 failed, 854 passed, and base-suite.log carries the same two ids; the grep count, the -20 line delta and the EXIT=1 negative control are each recorded in the manifest and its logs, though the gate is a suite-delta plus probes rather than one named assertion.
justifications.fit: review.py follows the surrounding private-helper idiom, the commit at f363c5a35 carries a conventional subject and a body, and no name the repository forbids is introduced; the only fit slip is the retained _PLAN_ prefix on the now-shared pattern.
justifications.goal_fidelity: review.py:3455 _build_disposition_entry is called by both writers at review.py:3558 and :3628, review.py:795 holds the one remainder RUBRIC-line pattern and review.py:3587 the one key declaration, so each of the brief's three copies is collapsed without changing either public signature.
justifications.reuse: the change removes duplication rather than adding a capability: _build_disposition_entry extends reckon/crew/review.py, which already owns both writers, the pattern stays in its owner, and the key is declared in the module findings.py:37 already imports, so nothing is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --numstat 24b5ef0f4..f363c5a35 touches only reckon/crew/review.py, reckon/crew/findings.py and the in-fence evidence fragment, mutating no shared plan, index or sprint state and leaving the declared figures directory unused.
